caseNameFull: Nance v. Norris, Superintendent, Arkansas Department of Correction
judges: Application, Execution, Grant, Souter, Stay, Stevens

opinions.text:
C. A. 8th Cir. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice Thomas, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Cer-tiorari denied.

Justice Stevens, Justice Souter, and Justice Ginsburg would grant the application for stay of execution.
